scripts.build:packages: corepack pnpm --filter @radar/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @radar/sensor-github build && corepack pnpm --filter @radar/analysis build && corepack pnpm --filter @radar/storage build && corepack pnpm --filter @radar/runtime build
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @radar/server build && corepack pnpm --filter @radar/web build
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c green,cyan "corepack pnpm --filter @radar/server dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @radar/web dev"
scripts.test:engine: corepack pnpm run build:packages && node scripts/verify-engine.mjs
scripts.test:pipeline: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @radar/server build && corepack pnpm --filter @radar/web build && node scripts/verify-pipeline.mjs
scripts.test:validation-progress: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @radar/server build && corepack pnpm --filter @radar/web build && node scripts/verify-validation-progress.mjs
scripts.test:opencode: corepack pnpm run build:packages && node scripts/verify-opencode.mjs
scripts.test:demand-live: corepack pnpm run build && node scripts/verify-demand-live-http.mjs
scripts.test:codex: corepack pnpm run build:packages && node scripts/verify-codex.mjs
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run build:packages && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm -r typecheck
